description:
Outcome: coordinator views open problems and marks resolved, from brief.md First version 4.
Scope: accessible open list/detail, idempotent resolution timestamp and status history. Excludes: reopening, messaging and escalation.
Acceptance: all open reports visible only to coordinator; resolution removes from open list without deleting history.
Behaviour: safe report rendering and empty/loading/conflict/error recovery.
Verification: role/state-transition tests and report-to-resolution journey. Prerequisites: problem reporting. Assumptions: no reopen action in first version.
title: Coordinator problem resolution
